svg.title: GHCN-Daily weather station density
svg.desc: World map of 132,399 GHCN-Daily weather stations binned into 1.5 degree cells from 60 south to 84 north. The contiguous United States, southeastern Australia and western Europe are densely covered. The Sahara, Congo basin, Amazon interior, Arabian peninsula, Tibetan plateau, Siberia and Greenland are largely empty.
